title: DOLLARFR: one row inside a ten-formula structural sign-off on build 20026
status_plain: DOLLARFR's only Excel evidence is structural and it is a GROUP result. The scalar-parameter array-lift gap was signed off against live Excel with all ten representative reopened formulas re-evaluated, and DOLLARFR supplies one of those ten rows: =DOLLARFR(,{16,16}) returns a 1-by-2 array of #N/A where OxFunc had returned #VALUE!. The build is named on the sign-off sentence, which is unusual and worth crediting. What DOLLARFR does NOT have is any numeric bit-exactness evidence: nothing in this stream or anywhere else compares DOLLARFR's arithmetic to Excel's.
